_comment: Upstream sources for scripts/check-prefix-drift.js. Each 'watch' entry: fetch url, check that 'declared' still appears verbatim. Missing = upstream moved/renamed the prompt — re-read the file, append the new prefix to surfaces/<name>/index.js AND test/surfaces/prefixes.snapshot.json, keep the old one. 'unwatched' entries have no public source; they are checked by prefix snapshot tests only.
